name: quay_ask
description: Ask the operator one question beside this terminal, when you need a decision or an answer before you go on. The call stays open for the answer, up to 100 seconds, and returns {"answers": [{"question", "chosen", "text"}]}: the label the operator picked in a list, which is empty when they only wrote, and what they wrote, left out when they wrote nothing. Nothing is picked for them, and the question has a text box of its own, so add no option for "other".

options.description: Two to six options, of which the operator picks one.

label.description: At most 60 characters, and no other option's.

recommended.description: True on at most one option, marked as your pick.

name: quay_surface_read
description: Read where one of this terminal's surfaces stands, by the id a call returned. Use it for an answer you did not get, not to wait for one: the answer is typed into this terminal. Returns {"surface_id", "state", "result"}: state is shown, no_answer_yet, answered or dismissed, and result is there only when answered.
